summary: Partner testimonial on the Microsoft Reskill program, part of the #BCTalent initiative, which combines recruiting, training, onboarding and mentoring of new candidates for the Business Central ecosystem. The partner says candidates became billable after 12 weeks and that doing this alone would cost more.
overview:
A short partner testimonial from the Business Central channel about the #BCTalent initiative and its Reskill program. The partner describes how hard it has been to find people with the right technical or business skills, and why a Microsoft initiative that fits the kind of consultant they want was worth joining.

The partner highlights that Reskill covers recruiting, training, onboarding and mentoring in one program. In their experience candidates became billable after 12 weeks, and running all of this in-house would have been more expensive. The video closes with a call for other partners to join, stating that the future is Business Central and the time to switch is now.
key_points: Finding candidates with the right technical or business skills has been a long-standing struggle for partners.
Partners compete for the same candidates and cannot keep hiring from each other; the growing market needs new talent.
The partner was excited about Reskill because it aligned with the kind of consultant they were trying to develop.
Reskill combines recruiting, training, onboarding and mentoring of candidates in one program.
The partner reports candidates became billable after 12 weeks.
The partner says doing all of this themselves would be much more expensive.
The video is part of the #BCTalent initiative, where Microsoft works with partners to grow the Business Central talent pool.
